Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Volunteer Shift Timetable
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创听力练习，主题是日常安排与习惯。请先听录音（或阅读文本），然后完成8道题。题目均为英文，解释为中文。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Leo. This is my volunteer shift. I help at the food bank on Saturdays.
Leo: Nice. What time do you start?
Mia: We start at nine. We open at nine thirty.
Leo: Do you work alone?
Mia: No, I don't. We work in a team. I sort cans. You can help too.
Leo: Great. I have free time on Saturday mornings. Do you finish at noon?
Mia: No, we don't. We finish at one. We take a break at eleven.
Leo: How often do you volunteer?
Mia: I volunteer every week. My sister volunteers twice a month.
Leo: Perfect. I can come this Saturday.
Mia: Good. Please arrive at eight forty-five.

questions.prompt: What time does the volunteer shift start?
questions.explanation: Mia说“We start at nine.”，所以开始时间是九点。

questions.prompt: What time does the food bank open?
questions.explanation: Mia说“We open at nine thirty.”，所以开门时间是九点半。

questions.prompt: How does Mia work at the food bank?
questions.explanation: Leo 问 Do you work alone?，Mia 回答 No, I don't. We work in a team.，明确说她和团队一起做志愿工作。Leo 只是说这个星期六可以来，不能据此说他每周都与她一起工作。
questions.evidence:
Leo: Do you work alone?
Mia: No, I don't. We work in a team.

questions.prompt: What is Mia's job during the shift?
questions.explanation: Mia 说 I sort cans.，即“我整理罐头”。题目问她值班时负责的工作，Sorting cans 与原句的 sort cans 对应；另外两项工作没有在对话中出现。
Leo问“Do you finish at noon?”，Mia回答“No, we don't. We finish at one.”，所以结束时间是一点。
questions.evidence: No, we don't. We finish at one.

questions.prompt: What time do they take a break?
questions.explanation: Mia说“We take a break at eleven.”，所以休息时间是十一点。
questions.evidence: We take a break at eleven.

questions.prompt: How often does Mia volunteer? (two words)
questions.explanation: Mia说“I volunteer every week.”，所以频率是每周。

questions.prompt: What time should Leo arrive? Use NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the conversation.
questions.explanation: 最后的要求是 Please arrive at eight forty-five.，即8:45；这是 Leo 应当到达的时间。nine 是开始工作，nine thirty 是开门时间。题目要求使用录音中的英文词，所以填写 eight forty-five（two words；forty-five 为一个连字符词）。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，实义动词用原形，不加 -s。例如：I help、you work、we start、they finish。否定形式用 don't + 动词原形，例如：I don't work。疑问形式用 Do + 主语 + 动词原形？例如：Do you volunteer? 回答用 Yes, I do. 或 No, I don't.

questions.prompt: I ___ at the food bank on Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 help。
questions.evidence: I help at the food bank on Saturdays.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 start。
主语是 they，动词用原形 work。
主语是 you，一般现在时疑问句用 Do 开头。
主语是 I，否定用 don't + 动词原形。
主语是 we，否定用 don't + 动词原形。

questions.prompt: ___ they take a break at eleven?
questions.explanation: 主语是 they，疑问句用 Do 开头。
questions.evidence: Do they take a break at eleven?

questions.prompt: You ___ cans at the food bank.
questions.explanation: 主语是 you，动词用原形 sort。
questions.evidence: You sort cans at the food bank.
